newsitem.title: japan: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 2.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese
press on Monday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Mitsui Toatsu Chemicals Inc and Sumitomo Chemical Co Ltd agree to integrate polystyrene business.
-- Nippon Life Insurance Co to increase dividend for the first time in seven years.
-- Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd gave 500 million yen to corporate racketeer Ryuichi Koike in guarantee money for futures trading of stocks at Nomura Securities Co Ltd.
-- 53 out of 100 major firms say they will hire more new graduates for the next year starting April 1.
-- Majority of prefectural governors avoid attending war dead memorial services at Shinto shrines.
-- Key reform panel to propose cutting interim defence build-up programme by one trillion yen.
-- NHK considering launching digital TV services on communication satellite.
